# TrustyPopover

`Overlays` · composition depth: `base`

A floating panel anchored to its trigger, opened by a click and dismissed by clicking outside or pressing Escape. The panel is interactive: put a small form, a set of settings, or a confirmation flow in it.

**Use it when**
- the user needs to deliberately open an overlay to interact with its content.
- use very sparingly.

**Don't use it for**
- purely informational content that needs no action: use TrustyHoverCard.
- a few words of clarification on a control: use TrustyTooltip.
- a plain list of commands: use TrustyDropdownMenu.
- opening actions that could be simplified by removing any nesting.
- another popover's content: NEVER trigger a popover from inside one.

```ts
import { TrustyPopover } from '@louislp/trusty-ui'
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | — | Heading for the panel, rendered as an overline. Also names the dialog for assistive tech. |
| `description` | `string` | — | Optional supporting line beneath the title. |
| `side` | `"top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left"` | `"bottom"` | Which edge of the trigger the panel is anchored to |
| `alignment` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | `"center"` | How the panel is aligned relative to the trigger |
| `modal` | `boolean` | `false` | Trap focus and block interaction with the rest of the page while open |
| `modelValue` | `boolean` | `false` | Open state. Drive with `v-model`, or leave it to the `#trigger` slot. |

## Events

- `update:modelValue` — `[value: boolean]`

## Slots

- `trigger`
- `default`

## Examples in Storybook

- Default — Default: title, description, and a slotted control — the design's shape.
- TitleOnly — Title only — drop the description when the heading says enough.
- ContentOnly — No header at all: the panel is whatever you slot into it.
- Right — Anchor to any edge of the trigger.
- Top
- StartAligned — Align the panel to the start or end of the trigger.
- Modal — Modal — focus is trapped in the panel and the page behind it is inert.
- SettingsPanel — Several controls in one panel, with the actions the flow needs.
